pages.text: Fizz is a little dragon, but he can eat a lot. He eats ten buns in one day!
pages.picture: baby dragon happily eating a pile of buns

pages.text: But one day, Fizz will not eat. He sits on the step and looks out at the hills.
pages.picture: baby dragon sitting on a doorstep looking at far hills
girl kneeling beside the sad dragon

pages.text: Fizz points his claw at the highest hill. "That is Dragon Hill," he said. "My mum is up there."
pages.picture: dragon pointing a claw at a tall misty hill

pages.text: "I miss her," said Fizz. A big tear drips down his cheek.
pages.picture: close-up of the baby dragon with a tear on his cheek

pages.text: Yara hugs Fizz. "Then we will go to her," she said.
That night, Yara packs her bag. A torch, a coat, and ten jam buns for Fizz.
pages.picture: girl packing a backpack by lamplight

pages.text: At dawn, they set off. Dragon Hill is far away, but Yara is not afraid. The quest starts now!
pages.picture: girl and dragon setting off at sunrise toward the hill
